title: Local variables and method completion
capture_method: Actual VS Code window frames from native typing, mouse selections, and Show Hover; cropped and retimed. Not continuous video or a latency measurement.
source_changes: src/capabilities/completion/mod.rs: wait for the active document edit before reading completion candidates
steps: Read the Notebook class and its local variable.
Type not to see the automatic local-variable suggestion.
Type .ti to see the title method and its String result.
Use Show Hover on the completed call to inspect String.
notes: Recorded in an extension development host using the identified source build and working-tree change.
The initial source omits the final method call from the fixture; the clip adds it.
Word suggestions and snippets are disabled so the list shows language-server results.
Read pauses and ordinary typing gaps are edited. Pointer motion between captured frames is not continuous.
